external_entities.name: colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues who sign in through the identity broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.
external_entities.notes: Their exact location is not specified beyond including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues from franchise stores who authenticate through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The specific franchise locations and the provider's permitted colleagues are not documented.

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies colleague group membership changes to the identity broker overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.
external_entities.notes: The HR system's location, technology, and security properties are not stated.

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider operated by franchise colleagues' own organization that vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The provider's name, location, and which colleagues it is allowed to vouch for are not documented.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, imports directory changes, and records sign-ins in an audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.
processes.notes: The broker signs tokens with a shared signing key and accepts franchise identity-provider sign-in.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses group membership in a token to authorize price changes and transaction voids for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: The store where the identity broker keeps its token-signing key.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_stores.notes: Whether the key store is encrypted at rest is not documented.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory of colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: Whether the directory is encrypted where it sits is not documented.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: The log to which the identity broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: What the log records and whether it covers the franchise route are not documented. Whether it is encrypted where it sits is also not documented.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Colleagues sign in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are
data_flows.notes: The sign-in mechanism and data carried during sign-in are not specified.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Franchise colleagues enter through the identity broker using their own identity provider's vouching.
data_flows.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.
data_flows.notes: The exact franchise sign-in exchange is not documented.

data_flows.name: vouch
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for franchise colleagues to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: The protocol and authentication details are not documented.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls colleague and group-membership changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.notes: The protocol and transport protection are not documented.

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker updates its directory with HR-supplied colleague and group-membership changes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.notes: The directory update mechanism is not documented.
data_flows.data_description: colleagues and the groups they are in

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The records written and whether franchise sign-ins are included are not documented.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token that the store admin console uses for authorization.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: staff id and group membership token

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the token-signing key from the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.notes: The protocol and transport protection are not documented.
data_flows.data_description: public half of the signing key

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home devices
trust_boundaries.description: Colleagues' own devices at home from which they sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise organizational environment that is allowed to use the system.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store contains confidential data because it holds the token-signing key.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the key store holds a signing key.

assumptions.assumption: The directory contains confidential data because it holds colleague identities and group memberships.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the directory holds colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log contains personally identifiable data because it records sign-ins.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the broker writes sign-ins to the audit log.
